verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents waitpoint tokens, which pause a running task until the token is completed externally; the docs present this as the mechanism for approval workflows and external confirmation. That is the core of signaling a specific running workflow from outside, and tool-level `needsApproval` pauses plus durable multi-turn chat tasks that receive conversation turns reinforce it. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that tokens can be completed via a REST API call or webhook URL, workflow-to-workflow signaling, arbitrary event or message payloads beyond token completion, and independent hands-on corroboration.
